title: Rain at the campsite
summary: A family's first camping holiday goes wrong in every possible way, and they love it.
paragraphs: The Molina family had never been camping. They bought a tent, four sleeping bags, a small gas cooker and a lot of tins of beans. Their friends said that the mountains in August were perfect: warm days, cool nights and no rain. They drove for four hours to a campsite next to a river.

Putting up the tent took two hours. The {{instructions}} were in six languages, but none of them seemed to describe the tent they had. When they finally finished, there was one piece left over, and nobody knew where it went. "It's probably not important," said Mr Molina.

That night it rained. It wasn't light rain. It was a storm, with thunder that {{echoed}} in the valley. At two in the morning, they discovered what the extra piece was for: it held up the corner of the tent where Lucía and her brother were sleeping. Water came in, and their sleeping bags got wet.

The family ran to the car and spent the rest of the night there, {{wrapped}} in towels and eating biscuits. The children thought it was the best night of their lives. In the morning, the sun came out, and everything in the campsite was hanging from trees to dry. Their neighbours, an older couple from Holland, came over with hot chocolate. They had been camping for forty years, and they showed the family how to put the extra piece in the right place.

The rest of the week was perfect. They swam in the river, walked to a waterfall and cooked beans every night, because they had brought far too many tins. On the last evening, the Dutch couple invited them for dinner. "Will you come back next year?" they asked. "Yes," said Lucía before her parents could answer. "But we'll bring fewer beans."

instructions.meaning: information that tells you how to do something

echoed.meaning: made a sound that repeated because it hit hills or walls

questions.question: Why did the family choose August?
options: It was the only time they were free.
Their friends said the weather would be perfect.
questions.explanation: Their friends said the mountains in August were perfect: warm days and no rain.

questions.question: What was the problem with the instructions?
options: None of them seemed to describe their tent.

questions.question: Why did water come into the tent?
options: They had not used the extra piece that held up a corner.

questions.question: How did the Dutch couple help?
options: They lent them a new tent.
